requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O1 (must pass: yes)
requirements.statement: When the PR head has moved since this run last judged a head (another session pushed to the branch, e.g. a base merge), the merge step catches up with the new head: it brings the local branch to it, waits for CI on it, and merges it pinned to it with `gh pr merge --match-head-commit <new head>`. The run never ends STUCK asking for a hand merge just because the head moved.

requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O2 (must pass: yes)
requirements.statement: Custody's rule is kept: the merge is pinned only to a head whose CI passed in this run (or whose CI failures the owner's findings bar accepted) and whose custody check passes. A moved head whose CI fails is never merged, and goes to the existing red-head fix loop instead.

requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O3 (must pass: no)
requirements.statement: When the moved head carries commits that are more than a base merge, the run collects findings on it (through the merge step's existing fix loop, when the owner's ship.md gives it one) before merging.

requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O4 (must pass: no)
requirements.statement: A run that is already stuck on a moved head (its saved step list predates this fix) recovers on `/ship-build --resume` with no restart.

tasks.description: Add `sync-head` to `merge-up.js` (library function and CLI verb) with unit tests. Depends on: none. Serves: O1, O3, O4. Acceptance: cases (a)-(i) against a real git repo with bare origin and stubbed gh: up-to-date returns moved false; base-only push fast-forwards with baseOnly true and sync fast-forward; feature-file push gives baseOnly false with path in changed; judged equal to pushed head but local behind still fast-forwards; local record-only commit gives sync merged and custody reconcile no longer refuses; local src commit not on tip gives ok false with local HEAD unchanged; MERGED PR gives moved false, CLOSED PR gives ok false; gh failure gives ok false; judged none gives moved true.

ship-sequencer.js: loop-on takes a list (loopOnAll), record matches the live contract's list, next adds the reserved loop input. Depends on: none. Serves: O3, O4. Acceptance: unit tests (a)-(e) covering list parsing and refusal of unknown words, moved looping and bound ending stuck, snapshot loop.on string still honoured, next giving input.loop with rounds dropping per attempt, and a parameter named loop refused; existing ship-sequencer and ship-primitives tests pass unchanged.

Contract and command prose: merge contract step 0 sync-head, CI wait on every head not equal to context.judgedHead, moved result and data, judgedHead on red, loop-on red and moved; wait-ci and collect-findings record judgedHead; ship-build.md Step 4 names loop and both loop words; guide describes moved-head path; ship-primitives.test.js pins the prose. Depends on: FIX-001, FIX-002. Serves: O1, O2, O3. Acceptance: ship-primitives.test.js asserts the merge contract order, judgedHead passing, --match-head-commit observed head, moved declared in results, stops-on and loop-on with data, and wait-ci and collect-findings declaring judgedHead; all contracts load through loadPrimitives with no errors.

Seam test in ship-build.seam.test.js: CI green on A, another session pushes B, resume, merge B. The gh stub refuses pr merge with a mismatched --match-head-commit. New cases (a) base-only move merges B with the exact merge log; (b) red on B gives red with judgedHead B and no merge; (c) non-base move with loop hands out collect-findings then merges B; (d) red head accepted by the findings bar merges with no second CI wait; (e) await-approval recorded head B unjudged still syncs and waits; (f) old snapshot loop.on red with no judgedHead still reaches merged on B. Depends on: FIX-001, FIX-002, FIX-003. Serves: O1, O2, O3, O4.

Mirror every edited packages/core file into packages/full and .claude; CHANGELOG Unreleased entry naming #98; CLAUDE.md known-open check. Depends on: FIX-001, FIX-002, FIX-003, FIX-004. Serves: O1. could_not_verify: The Storybook incident itself (islayjames/storybook PRs #75 and #81) was not replayed; the reproduction above is the same sequence in a scratch repo.

Whether a model session follows the new contract prose is not proven by the seam test, which plays the lead. An optional live proof in islayjames/ship-build-live-test is allowed; its one PR slot is held by PR #3.

A run whose record predates judgedHead waits for CI once on its current head at the merge. If that head's CI failures had been accepted below the owner's findings bar before this fix, the wait reads them as red and sends them through the fix loop once more. Only runs in flight across the upgrade can meet this.
